messages:
sara_support: Heads-up — multiple customers sending in tickets about dashboard graphs not loading. They see 500s from the analytics API and some charts are just blank with a spinner. Happening since ~09:10 UTC.

matt_eng: Which endpoint is failing? stack or browser network traces?

sara_support: From one customer (acct: acme-inc) network tab shows POST /v1/analytics/query -> 500, response body: {"error":"internal"} and a request_id header like req_0a1b2c. Also seeing timeouts (504) in some other tenants.

devon_eng: I pulled alerts: infra-alert-bot posted a spike for analytics-api error_rate at 2026-03-16T09:09:30Z. Link: https://grafana.company/alert/3456 :eyes:

infra-alert-bot: [alert] analytics-api: error_rate > 5% (5m) — hosts: analytics-01..05 — current: 12%

matt_eng: Can someone paste the proxy logs and a sample backend stacktrace? Also, are the KV cache misses high?

devon_eng: Quick snippet from analytics-api logs for req_0a1b2c: 
```
2026-03-16T09:09:31Z ERROR handler.go:143 request_id=req_0a1b2c query_id=qx9 runtime error: failed to fetch shard results: context deadline exceeded
stack: runtime error: non‑nil error
```

matt_eng: That looks like a downstream storage timeout. Which storage cluster did that query hit?

devon_eng: The request fan‑out went to clickhouse-replica-2 which shows high CPU and several long running queries >60s. I see a small deploy rolled on clickhouse yesterday with a config tweak (merge_threads -> 2).

sara_support: Repro steps from customer: open Dashboard -> choose time range last 1h -> hover over panel -> spinner -> open devtools shows network POST /v1/analytics/query 500. Happens for multiple dashboards, not just one.

ops_oncall: Rolling back that clickhouse config now to previous (merge_threads=4), will monitor. Starting at 09:14 UTC.

matt_eng: Thanks. In the meantime add a temporary retry with longer timeout in analytics-proxy for 5xxs so user requests don't surface immediate 500s. We should also surface a helpful error message in Console instead of blank panels.

devon_eng: Implemented a proxy retry (3x, backoff 200ms) + extended upstream timeout 45s for query endpoints. Patch deployed to staging, pushing to prod canary to analytics-proxy-03.

infra-alert-bot: [deploy] analytics-proxy v1.12.3-canary deployed to analytics-proxy-03 by devops (deployed_at=2026-03-16T09:18:10Z)

sara_support: Customers notified in support tickets about mitigation and ETA. One asked if this caused billing spikes — verified metrics show no unexpected token count changes, just delayed responses.

matt_eng: Postmortem checklist: 1) rollback clickhouse config change (done) 2) add query timeout visibility to console (user-facing) 3) add rate limit / shed policy on heavy ad-hoc queries 4) improve circuit-breaker in analytics-proxy.

devon_eng: I'll open an RFC for query-shedding and add a dashboard that correlates clickhouse long queries with console 500s. Also adding alerts for replica CPU > 85% + long running queries > 30s.

ops_oncall: Clickhouse metrics returning to normal after rollback. Error rate dropped to 1.2% at 09:25 UTC.

sara_support: Closing customer-facing escalations if they confirm. Will ping here if any reopen. :thumbsup:
